research_question: After preserving the v5 long-holiday A50 closure layer, does ordinary-session same-contract SGX FTSE China A50 price discovery from the previous mainland close to immediately before the next mainland opening call auction add explanatory information about the CSI1000 09:31 opening gap?
financial_rationale: Ordinary A-share closures leave a daily interval during which directly China-linked SGX A50 futures can absorb overseas and China-specific information. A daily pre-auction A50 move should be more economically targeted than adding broad Japan or Europe indices and tests an information channel rather than generic technical fit.

clock_rationale.reason: exclude mainland call-auction formation from the primary offshore feature and measure only information available before that target-market price-discovery process begins

data_contract.provider: Singapore Exchange official historical derivatives endpoint at links.sgx.com

navigation_index.role: date-to-SGX-file-key navigation only; no market price content

data_contract.market_rows_used: only official SGX CN futures trade records after schema-specific validation
data_contract.raw_archive_policy: full-market SGX zip archives remain ephemeral; every used archive URL/key/SHA256, detected schema, CN-row count and eligible-trade count must be frozen in compact manifests
data_contract.pre_2016_schema_gate: the existing early-2015 zero-trade anomaly must be resolved and covered by tests before bulk model execution; if old-format trade semantics cannot be established, affected rows remain unavailable and no heuristic reinterpretation may be chosen from model results

contract_selection.selection_time: previous China trading date at or before 15:00:00 Singapore/Beijing time
contract_selection.eligible_records: validated CN futures trade records observable by that time
contract_selection.rule: among contract month-years with an eligible prior-close trade, choose the chronologically nearest delivery month-year not earlier than the previous China calendar month
contract_selection.missing_target_same_contract: mark row unavailable; do not switch contract or impute

a50_ordinary_preauction_closure_return.start: last selected-contract trade at or before previous China trading date 15:00:00
a50_ordinary_preauction_closure_return.end: last same-contract trade at or before target China date 09:14:59
a50_ordinary_preauction_closure_return.reason_for_zero_on_holidays: preserve the already-frozen V5A holiday A50 mechanism and test only the missing ordinary-session information channel

v5_holiday_feature.name: a50_holiday_closure_return
v5_holiday_feature.definition: unchanged from frozen v5 receipt and preregistration

data_quality_gates_before_model.if_any_hard_gate_fails: do not execute or adjudicate v6; repair data/schema/clock only without changing feature or model definitions

attempts.features: frozen v4 feature set + frozen V5A holiday A50 closure feature, refit only on the exact v6 common training sample

common_sample.rule: comparator and V6A use identical training and holdout rows; a row requiring ordinary A50 is included only when same-contract endpoints exist under the frozen rule; holiday availability follows the frozen V5A data rule
common_sample.missing_row_rule: exclude from both candidates and report the cause; no imputation, forward-fill, contract switch or sample-specific fallback

primary_adjudication.same_sample_R2: V6A holdout R2 must be greater than comparator holdout R2
primary_adjudication.equivalent_SSE_check: on the same target sample, V6A holdout SSE must be lower than comparator holdout SSE
primary_adjudication.IC: V6A holdout IC must be greater than comparator holdout IC
primary_adjudication.sign_hit: V6A sign hit may not deteriorate by more than 0.01 absolute
primary_adjudication.annual_stability: V6A SSE must not be worse than comparator in either 2019 or 2020; report annual IC and sign hit without post-hoc year exclusion
primary_adjudication.quarterly_diagnostic: report all eight 2019-2020 calendar-quarter SSE differences and IC differences; require positive total SSE improvement, positive median quarterly SSE improvement and at least five of eight quarters with nonnegative SSE improvement
primary_adjudication.holiday_preservation: report the frozen holiday subset separately; because the new ordinary feature is zero there, material holiday deterioration caused by refitting is a warning and may block progression if holiday SSE becomes worse than the common-sample comparator

nonselectable_diagnostics.09_24_59_daily_variant: not selectable and not part of phase-6 model ranking; may be used only in a future separately preregistered timing study because it overlaps mainland opening call auction

forbidden: A50 target endpoint at or after 09:15:00 for the selectable ordinary-session feature
target mainland call-auction price or order-flow variables
continuous-contract splice inside a feature interval
feature or model family search after seeing v6 results
using the 25%-35% aspiration as a search target
mutating the frozen V5A unseen-controller contract
